evidence.AC1: POST /todos with {"title":"past","dueDate":"2026-10-14"} returned 201 with dueDate "2026-10-14". POST without dueDate returned 201 with dueDate null. The date is a plain YYYY-MM-DD string with no time.
evidence.AC2: PATCH /todos/4 with {"dueDate":"2025-05-05"} returned 200, and a following GET showed the new date. PATCH with {"dueDate":null} returned 200 with dueDate null, so the date was removed.
evidence.AC3: On POST, dueDate "2026-02-30", "15.10.2026", "2026-2-3" and the number 20261015 each returned 400. On PATCH, "2026-02-30" also returned 400.
evidence.AC4: With today = 2026-10-15, I created todos due yesterday, today, in the future, with no date, and a past-due todo that I marked done. GET /todos?overdue=true returned only the todo due yesterday. The done todo, the one due today, the future one and the undated one were all excluded.
evidence.AC5: The page at / listed every todo that has a due date with 'Fällig: <date>' (2026-10-14, 2026-10-15, 2026-12-01, 2026-01-01). The undated todo showed no date.
evidence.AC6: In the page snapshot, only the todo due 2026-10-14 had the text 'überfällig'. The todos due today, in the future, with no date, and the done past-due one had no such marker.
evidence.AC7: The page has a checkbox labelled 'nur überfällige'. After I clicked it, the list showed only the 'past' todo, which is the overdue one.
